callbacks.name: ke_log_callback
callbacks.doc: Receives one line a plugin library logged. Each plugin library exports ` <library >_set_log_callback(ke_log_callback callback, void *ctx)`, declared in its ` <library >_log.h`; the host sets it once, before the library logs, and a NULL callback sends the library's lines to stderr, which is also where they go until it is set. Called on whichever thread logged.

lanes.name: ctx
lanes.doc: The pointer given to the setter, unchanged.

lanes.name: level
lanes.doc: How severe the line is: error, warning, info or debug.

lanes.name: scope
lanes.doc: The name of what logged: the plugin, or a third-party library it routes. Valid only during the call.

lanes.name: message
lanes.doc: The formatted line. Valid only during the call.

type_aliases.ke_log_callback: void (*)(void *, ke_log_level, const char *, const char *)
